requirements.title: Versioned ModelCapabilityProfile with expiry and evidence-based claims
evidence: backend suite 1241/1241; tsc --noEmit clean
requirements.notes: Every score carries provenance and an expiry. A declared score is a labelled prior with confidence 0.3; an observed score is computed from recorded build, test, patch and repair outcomes and replaces the prior at MIN_OBSERVATIONS. needsRevalidation reports a profile that expired or was never measured. A stored profile with no expiry is treated as expired rather than immortal.

requirements.title: Benchmark definitions and persisted results
evidence: backend suite 1241/1241; tsc --noEmit clean
requirements.notes: 22 benchmark definitions covering the section 21 task list. Every one is settled by executable evidence rather than a model rating itself. sampleBenchmarks returns a bounded subset and excludes heavy benchmarks by default, so a user request never pays for the full suite.

requirements.title: Capability-based routing with evidence-based failover
evidence: backend suite 1241/1241; tsc --noEmit clean
requirements.notes: Ranks whatever profiles it is handed and names no model, so a new provider is routable by having a profile. Evidence beats assertion: a measured 7 outranks a hand-written 9 through confidence weighting. Hard requirements filter rather than penalise. Security-sensitive work refuses an unmeasured profile. Fallbacks are ranked in advance so failover is justified rather than arbitrary.
